title: (Conditional) DNA structural-variant track (Manta/GRIDSS/SvABA) if open data exists
context: M5 conditional DNA structural-variant track for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Adds DNA-SV callers (Manta, GRIDSS, SvABA) ONLY if redistributable/open ES WGS/WES with documented fusions exists and compliance confirms it; otherwise the track is formally deferred with documented rationale. The open-data and compliance guardrails strictly gate this work - no controlled-access WGS is used.
objective: Add a DNA-SV caller track (Manta/GRIDSS/SvABA) gated on compliance-confirmed open ES WGS/WES with documented fusions, or formally defer with a documented rationale.
acceptanceCriteria: Only proceeds if redistributable/open ES WGS/WES with documented fusions exists (compliance-confirmed); otherwise formally deferred with rationale.
If built: DNA-SV callers run behind the uniform adapter on the pinned reference with full provenance and CI smoke tests.
output: A pull request adding the DNA-SV track (dna-sv/) or a documented deferral rationale.
